item.title: Can African penguins be brought back from the brink? Better designed no-fishing zones could help
item.description: New research suggests that better-designed no-fishing zones could help save the critically endangered African penguins. A 2025 court ruling established a 20km no-fishing zone around Robben Island, aiming to protect penguin foraging grounds and improve chick survival rates.

item.title: A viral monkey, his plushie & a 70-year-old experiment: What Punch tells us about attachment theory
item.description: Punch, a baby macaque at Ichikawa City Zoo, clings to an orangutan plushie, echoing Harlow's 1950s experiments that highlight emotional nourishment's role in attachment, challenging the behaviorist view that physical needs alone form bonds.
